pulse rate, in beats per minute, was found to have a mean of 148.6 and a standard deviation of

7 The faces of a biased die are numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. The probabilities of throwing odd numbers
are all the same. The probabilities of throwing even numbers are all the same. The probability of
throwing an odd number is twice the probability of throwing an even number.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability of throwing a 3.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: The die is thrown three times. Find the probability of throwing two 5s and one 4.

The die is thrown 100 times. Use an approximation to find the probability that an even number
is thrown at most 37 times.
